text:
Maya: posted a photo of my ridiculous window-sill mini-greenhouse + ring light setup. glare totally nukes my camera, any quick tips? :seedling: :camera_with_flash:
DevBot: uploaded 1 file
Alex: try angling the ring light up and diffusing it. paper napkin or tracing paper taped to a spare embroidery hoop works in a pinch. lower the brightness a touch.
Maya: tried the napkin, made it worse lol, everything looked foggy
Chris: clamp a small LED panel to the side and bounce off the wall, or put a dimmable panel behind the plant for backlight. less direct on-camera light helps with glare.
Maya: hmm curious — will moving the light behind the plant still keep the plant visible on camera?
Sam: yes, backlight gives depth. for direct camera control on linux you can tweak: `v4l2-ctl --set-ctrl=brightness=180,contrast=40,saturation=60` (obs & mac have sliders too).
Leah: quick poll — who else has a desk jungle? react with :seedling: for yes, :deciduous_tree: for maybe, :no_entry_sign: for nope
Alex: :seedling:
Chris: :seedling:
Sam: :seedling:
Ben: :no_entry_sign:
Maya: thanks gang — going to angle the ring and rig a better diffuser, will post an after pic :thumbsup:
Maya: posted "after" pic — much softer, camera no longer looks like an aquarium :grin:
